facts.text: I am thinking of ordering food for the next game.
I watched the Kansas City Chiefs defeat the Buffalo Bills in the Divisional Round of the NFL playoffs last weekend.
I watched the game at my friend Mike's place.
I am a big fan of buffalo wings.
We had a bunch of buffalo wings at Mike's place while watching the Chiefs game.
There were about 5 people at Mike's place.
I want a place that can handle a decent-sized order for about 5 people.
I think I will go with Buffalo Wild Wings.
I have been to Buffalo Wild Wings before.
Their wings are always a hit for me.
I am planning to order online and pick it up.
I want to avoid waiting for delivery.
I want to customize my order and pay ahead of time.
I am also thinking of having pizza with my wings.
I want pizza deals or combos that I can add to my order.
I think I will go with the Pizza and Wings Combo.
I will choose the medium "Blazin' BBQ" pizza.
I want to add an order of potato wedges to my combo.
